report.review_notes: Academic author/supervisor/lecturer attribution, laboratory logos, game/editor screenshots and diagrams. No credentials, account dashboards, private contact details or signing material identified. Original metadata retained. No redaction required.

image.visual_review: Historical game artwork; no people, account screens or private contact details identified.

scope_limit: A document/image review does not establish software licensing, application safety, buildability or current hardware compatibility.

editorial_review.mode: Actual read-only review with tools disabled
editorial_review.scope: README prose and source/date/award/runtime/license implications, supplied with verified project/report/notice facts
editorial_review.factual_suggestions_checked: Gameplay and screenshots checked against all six report pages; final-presentation wording and lab name checked against the official project page. No application execution by the reviewer is claimed.
